_help: Pipeline settings for the OSU Robotics Club rover (Rover_2026_2027). Use: mrc-urdf prepare rover.urdf --config urdf-pipeline/config/osu_rover.json
_fix_inertia: The URDF's drivetrain/body/camera inertias are 3-190x larger than their shapes allow; 15 are physically impossible (larger than with all the mass at the part's outer edge). CAD export error; reported upstream. Replace them with mesh-derived values.
_locked_joints: Each front side has a 'four-bar' (URDF comment: 'Four Bars Don't exist in URDF's'), but the commented-out back bogie joint puts the back bar's bogie pin at exactly the same point as the front bar's (to 6 decimals, both sides). Two bars meeting at one pin form a rigid triangle with the body: the links cannot move and the bogie pivots on that pin. So the link joints are locked; the bogie joints stay free (URDF limits +-15 deg, damping 2.0), like the rear bogie.
_drive_limits: Real drive chain (Rover_2026_2027/software/ros_packages/rover2_control): joy_to_drive.py MAX_LINEAR_VEL 3.7 m/s, MAX_ANGULAR_VEL 4 rad/s -> diff_drive_controller (config/rover_drive.yaml: update_rate 30 Hz, linear.x max_acceleration 2.0 m/s^2, angular.z max_acceleration 2.0 rad/s^2; deceleration = acceleration) -> ODrive ramped velocity mode (drive_can_control.py VEL_RAMP = 50*4 = 200 motor turns/s^2, gear ratio 50 -> 4 wheel rev/s^2). The controller mixes turns with its tuned wheel_separation 1.15 m and wheel_radius 0.146 m (rover_drive.yaml), so the simulated wheels get the same speed commands as the real ones.
_joint_limits: Real arm joint limits from Rover_2026_2027/software/ros_packages/rover2_arm/config/joint_limits.yaml (MoveIt). Shoulder is reduced there to 0.28 rad/s / 1.12 rad/s^2 ('should be by measured').
_physical_parameters: Every physical number the simulation depends on, with where it came from. status: measured > rover_code > urdf > cad > estimate > assumed. When the rover is measured, replace value/status/source here (docs/rover-measurement-guide.md) and re-run prepare.

total_mass_kg.source: URDF link masses (CAD export; the same export's inertia was physically impossible)
total_mass_kg.applies_to: all link masses (prepare scales them when this changes)

center_of_mass_offset_m.source: CAD centre of mass: 0.50 m above the ground, 1.8 cm ahead of the base origin
center_of_mass_offset_m.uncertainty: +/-5 cm assumed (height matters most: tip-over and braking limits)
center_of_mass_offset_m.applies_to: all link centres of mass (prepare shifts them)

wheel_radius_m.source: wheel collision mesh; rover code uses 0.146 (rover_drive.yaml, odometry-tuned) and 0.15 (drive_can_control.py WHEEL_CIRCUM)

tyre_mu_concrete_static.source: Not measured. Equals the friction the simulation used so far (Unity default wheel 0.6 averaged with the surface); typical rubber values span about 0.4-0.9
tyre_mu_concrete_static.applies_to: test course pad, Unity test ground

tyre_mu_concrete_dynamic.source: Not measured. Equals the friction the simulation used so far (Unity default wheel 0.6 averaged with the surface); typical rubber values span about 0.4-0.9
tyre_mu_concrete_dynamic.applies_to: test course pad, Unity test ground

wheel_max_torque_nm.source: No ODrive current limit / motor torque constant in the repo (they are stored on the controllers)

passive_joint_friction_nm.source: null = each joint's URDF <dynamics friction> (0.2 N*m on the bogie pivots)
passive_joint_friction_nm.applies_to: Coulomb friction on free bogie pivots

passive_joint_damping_nms.source: null = each joint's URDF <dynamics damping> (2.0 on the bogie pivots)
passive_joint_damping_nms.applies_to: viscous damping on free bogie pivots

arm_max_torque_nm.source: URDF effort=100 on every arm joint (looks like a placeholder; ODrive limits are not in the repo)

imu_rate_hz.source: Rover_2026_2027/software/ros_packages/rover2_odometry/rover2_odometry/imu08x.py DEFAULT_HERTZ (BNO08x); the URDF Gazebo block says 100
